title: First Real Project
goal: Change a real game's color and SAVE your own copy!
mascot_lines: Now it's your turn to build something real.
Pick a part of the game — the hero, the ground, or a block.
Then tap a color and watch the world change right in front of you.
When you like what you see, click Save to keep your version forever.

tier2.rephrase: Pick a part (Hero, Ground, or Block) first. Then pick a color. Then click Save.

tier3.nudge: Three steps: which part, which color, then save my world!
